text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen is always a big<n>event. The entrants
are chosen by<n>popular vote, so the lineup invariably
ends up being a who's who of the<n>best racers of
the year.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But this year, the atmosphere in the<n>stands is a little
different.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf is finally taking on<n>senior-year
racers... I can't wait to<n>see how she does!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Don't get your hopes up. Some of<n>these racers are
almost finished with<n>their careers. One of them's
gonna<n>snag the win, I figure.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Still, she's the Emperor, right? She'll<n>be top three
for sure.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ah, you're back. How's the mood<n>out there?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha... Are they now? How flattering.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
All eyes are on me. They hope that I<n>will measure
up favorably against the<n>seniors, as well as the
most talented<n>of my contemporaries.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But still, I have yet to capture their<n>hearts.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf came second in the<n>fan vote, losing
out to a senior-year<n>Umamusume, and it seems to
be<n>weighing on her mind.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A simple poll cannot truly measure<n>the people's
faith in me, of course,<n>but the result does symbolize
my<n>current standing quite aptly.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Many believe that the seniors'<n>experience
presents an obstacle that<n>I cannot hope to
overcome.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Which means that they doubt my<n>abilities. And such
doubts have only<n>one remedy.
choice_data_list: Let's show them how strong you really are!
